title: Model catalog bot PR labels and reviewers must be set on both the create and edit paths
answers: model catalog PR is missing team-review label
change reviewers on the auto-generated model catalog PR
why didn't the reviewer change apply to the existing catalog PR
update labels for the daily LiteLLM model pricing refresh PR
body:
Invariant: the bot's model-catalog PR labels and reviewers are applied on two separate branches of the same shell step in `.github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml`: the existing-PR branch (`gh pr edit "$existing_pr"`) and the new-PR branch (`gh pr create`). Change both together.
Enforced by: the `existing_pr=$(gh pr list --head "$branch" ...)` check, which picks the branch. No shared variable holds the label or reviewer set, so the two calls can drift apart.
What breaks: a change made only to `gh pr create` never reaches already-open catalog PRs. The daily rerun takes the edit branch and skips creation, so old reviewers stay and new labels are missing.
The PR's reviewer fix shows this: `--remove-reviewer` exists only on the edit call, and `--reviewer` was removed from the create call. `auto-rerun` is kept on both calls.
Constraints: applies only to PRs this workflow generates. Human-opened PRs on other branches are not touched.
applies: Any edit to reviewers, labels, or other PR metadata in the model catalog update workflow.
says: The automated daily model catalog pull request is missing the required team review label.
Update the assigned reviewers on the existing automated pull request for model catalog updates.
Reviewer updates were not applied to the currently open automated model pricing refresh pull request.
Daily catalog bot refresh pull requests keep old reviewers instead of picking up new assignments.
search: In .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml, model catalog pull request labels and reviewers must be set in both gh pr create and gh pr edit "$existing_pr" branches together. The branch is selected by existing_pr=$(gh pr list --head "$branch" ...), where changes made only to create skip daily reruns, keeping old reviewers while missing new labels. Reviewer removal uses --remove-reviewer on edit with --reviewer removed from create, auto-rerun stays on both, and this workflow does not touch human-opened pull requests on other branches.
